name: fractal
description: Fractal: change existing TypeScript and Python repos in place, only where a change needs, judged by the repo's own type check and tests; map them read-only; find architecture risks (dual writes, missing idempotency, twelve-factor, observability, module boundaries) and fix them with a verified plan, a modular monolith by default. The hosted engine plans and checks; model calls run on your Claude subscription (claude -p) and the checks run on your machine, in a copy.
